# gns3_image (Data Source)

Looks up an emulator image already on a compute, by exact file name, through `GET /v2/computes/{compute_id}/{emulator}/images`. Fails when the compute does not list the file. Read-only: it never uploads or changes anything. Docker images are not covered; GNS3 pulls those itself.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An image already on the compute, uploaded through the GNS3 GUI or copied
# into its images folder by hand.
data "gns3_image" "vyos" {
  emulator = "qemu"
  filename = "vyos-2026.10.07-0712-rolling-generic-amd64.iso"
}

output "vyos_image_md5" {
  value = data.gns3_image.vyos.md5sum
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `emulator` (String) Emulator whose images folder to search: one of `qemu`, `iou`, `dynamips`. `iou` exists only on Linux computes such as the GNS3 VM.
- `filename` (String) Exact file name, for example `vyos-rolling.iso`. A file in a subfolder or in another images folder is found by its base name; `path` says where it is.

### Optional

- `compute_id` (String) Compute to look on, for example `local` or `vm`. Default `local`.

### Read-Only

- `filesize` (Number) File size in bytes.
- `md5sum` (String) MD5 checksum the compute reports, lower-case hex.
- `path` (String) Path the compute reports: relative to the emulator's images folder (`QEMU`, `IOU` or `IOS`) when the file is inside it, absolute otherwise.
